blocks.value: Professional traders rarely rely on a single indicator. Instead, they combine different tools that support each other.
Imagine This: A doctor doesn't diagnose a patient using only body temperature. They also check blood pressure, oxygen level, medical history and symptoms. Traders follow a similar approach.
A common combination is Trend + Support/Resistance + RSI + Volume. If all four point in the same direction, traders have greater confidence in their decision.
A stock is in an uptrend, bounces from support, RSI rises above 50 and volume increases. Some traders consider this a stronger setup than using any one indicator alone.
⚠️ Adding too many indicators often creates confusion rather than clarity.
Master a few indicators before adding new ones to your charts.

blocks.question: Why do traders combine indicators?
choices: To gain more confidence in a trading decision.
To make charts look more colourful.
